cards.text: Jesus has been teaching the growing crowds (Luke 11:29), and as He's speaking, a Pharisee invites Him to dine with him. The Pharisees are a group of Jewish religious leaders. Jesus goes in and reclines at the table, and friend, after YEARS in a junk drawer hoping somebody would invite me anywhere, I'm already happy for Him.

cards.question: Jesus reclines at the Pharisee's table. What surprises the Pharisee?

answers.text: Jesus did not first wash before the meal
Jesus did not first give thanks for the meal
Jesus took the seat of honor at the meal

cards.text: Then the Lord says the Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish. Shiny lid on the cookie box, and nobody checking what's inside.

cards.question: When Jesus talks about the inside of the cup and dish, He's talking about what's inside the Pharisees.
Jesus says the Pharisees clean the outside. What does He say they're full of on the inside?

cards.text: Jesus doesn't tiptoe around it: "You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?"

cards.question: Jesus tells the Pharisees to give as alms the things within them. Then everything will be ___ for them.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "Woe to you Pharisees!" They tithe mint, rue and every herb, like me sorting sprinkles with TWEEZERS.

cards.question: The Pharisees tithe even their herbs, but Jesus says they disregard ___ and the love of God.
Jesus tells the Pharisees they can stop tithing their herbs.

cards.text: Jesus says, "You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former." Justice and the love of God, AND the mint, friend.
Woe number two: Jesus says the Pharisees love the greetings in the marketplaces. Honestly, friend? If nobody waves when I hop past, I hop past AGAIN.

cards.question: Jesus says the Pharisees love greetings in the marketplaces. What does He say they love in the synagogues?

cards.text: Woe number three, and the picture gets strange. Jesus says they're like unmarked graves.

cards.question: Jesus says the Pharisees are like unmarked graves. What do people do with graves like that?

answers.text: Go the long way around them

cards.text: Then one of the experts in the law speaks up. These are men who study and teach God's law.

cards.question: Jesus is calling out the Pharisees when an expert in the law speaks up. What does he tell Jesus?

answers.text: Your words are true and wise

cards.text: Friend, the man basically raised his hand to get INCLUDED. And Jesus replies, "Woe to you as well, experts in the law!"

cards.question: Jesus says the experts in the law weigh men down with heavy burdens. What does He say they won't do?

answers.text: Lift a finger to lighten the load
Explain the reason for the rules
Pay the men who carry them

cards.text: That's the boss who drops a stack on your desk at 4:59 and walks out whistling. Next woe: the experts build tombs for the prophets, but Jesus says it was their fathers who killed them.

cards.question: The experts in the law build tombs for the prophets their fathers killed. What does Jesus say that makes the experts?

answers.text: Witnesses consenting to their fathers' deeds

cards.text: Then Jesus says the wisdom of God spoke about sending prophets and apostles.

cards.question: Jesus tells what the wisdom of God said about sending prophets and apostles. What does it say will happen to those prophets and apostles?

answers.text: Some will be killed and others persecuted
Some will be welcomed and others ignored
Some will be followed and others forgotten

cards.text: As a result, Jesus says, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets.

cards.question: Jesus says the blood of the prophets charged to this generation goes all the way back to the foundation of the world.

cards.text: Jesus names it from the blood of Abel, killed by his brother Cain (Genesis 4:8), to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Then He says, "Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation."
Last woe, to the experts in the law: Jesus says they've taken away the key to knowledge. That's somebody walking off with the ONLY key to my bakery, friend, ONE key!

cards.question: Jesus says the experts in the law took away the key to knowledge and went in themselves.
The experts in the law took away the key to knowledge. What does Jesus say they did to those who were entering?

cards.text: Jesus goes on from there, and the scribes (teachers of the law) and Pharisees begin to oppose Him bitterly. Then the questions start, about many things, like a group chat that will NOT stop buzzing.

cards.question: The scribes and Pharisees ply Jesus with questions about many things. What are they waiting for?

answers.text: To catch Him in something He might say
To hear Him explain the Law to them
To hear Him take back all the woes
